### 1. Project

Example Owner intends to build a residential building (Class 1a) at 357 Catherine Street Lilyfield NSW 2040 (Inner West).

| The building | Site and planning | Delivery |
|---|---|---|
| Work type: New build | Site address: 357 Catherine Street Lilyfield NSW 2040 | Client: Example Owner |
| Building: Whole project: Class 1a, 250 m² GFA | Local government area: Inner West | Procurement route: Traditional lump sum |
| Storeys: 2 | Site area: 380 m² | Regulated design applies: No |
| Gross floor area: 250 m² | Planning pathway: Complying development certificate (CDC) |  |
| Bedrooms: 4 |  |  |
| Car parks: 1 |  |  |

Conditions that apply: Building over or next to a water authority asset.
Conditions that do not apply: Heritage item or conservation area; Connecting with Country input required; Work to an existing building; Site stays occupied or operating during the works; Delivered in stages; Several buildings or a campus; Parts with different NCC classes; Community consultation required; Green Star or NABERS target set; Client wants the consultant to administer the construction contract.

**Construction budget**: $1,800,000 excl. GST

### 2. Scope of services

Lead design consultant: you coordinate the consultants and integrate their work into your documents. You are not responsible for the accuracy of their work. The client engages the other consultants directly: Surveyor (to be appointed), Geotechnical (to be appointed). You engage these consultants as your subconsultants and include their fees in your price; name them in R4: Structural.

I = included; O = optional price; X = excluded; ? = scope unknown. Resolve unknown scope before issue; propose departures in R6.

### 4. Allowances

Price exactly these. Work beyond an allowance needs a written instruction (section 5) and is then charged at your R3 rates.

| Item | Allowance |
|---|---|
| Design meetings | 4 per stage, online or in person |
| Concept options | 2 |
| Client presentations | 2 |
| Working 3D views | 1 |
| Issues per stage | 1 draft and 1 final |
| Site visits, design stages | 2 |
| Drawing sheets at planning | 12, indicative; list them in R2 |
| Bidding ceiling | 40 hours |
| Construction site inspections | 6 |

### 5. Terms

- Engagement is under AIA Client and Architect Agreement (attached); your own terms do not apply. List any change you propose to the agreement in R6.
- Only a written instruction from the client's representative authorises extra scope, work beyond an allowance or a fee change; work without one is not paid.
- Each stage ends at client sign-off, which sets the baseline for later stages. Design development within the brief is not a variation; a client change after sign-off is assessed under the agreement.
- Correcting your own errors, or coordinating with information you were given, is not a variation.
- Invoice monthly against stage progress; payment within 30 days, not dependent on any authority approval.
- Your proposal stays valid for 90 days.
- Answers to scope questions go to every tenderer as numbered addenda.

### Returnable schedules: reply using this structure only

Reply in this order. The response form (Excel, issued with this RFP) has a table for each schedule and every fee row of section 3; return it with your proposal.

| Schedule | What to return |
|---|---|
| R2 Deliverables list | Each deliverable with its format, stage, review rounds and recipient; whether editable files are included and what reliance others may place on them. Drawing list: the sheets you expect at planning, tender and construction, with titles. |
| R3 Hourly rates | Excl. GST, for work authorised in writing beyond the allowances. Roles: Principal or Director · Associate or Senior architect · Project architect · Architect · Graduate or Technician · Interior designer · Administration. |
| R4 Team | Named lead, % time by stage, subconsultants; resources must match R7. Named director, project lead and project architect, with registration numbers. |
| R5 Experience | Two or three comparable projects in the last five years, each with a referee. Choose projects of the same use and work type. |
| R6 Departures | Each departure from sections 2–5 or the agreement: clause or item, proposed change, effect on fee and time; or "nil". A general exclusion not listed here is non-compliant. |
| R7 Program | Weeks by stage, separating your time, authority time and the dates you need inputs. |
| R8 Insurance and compliance | PI $10 million and PL $20 million with insurer and expiry; workers compensation; how you check your documents before issue (no certified system is needed); conflicts of interest. |
| R9 Reimbursables | "Included in the fee" (preferred), or each item with its rate. |
